cues: As the boat pulls away, the narrator feels no regret, only that invisible high wall.
The picture of the boy among the watermelons blurs.
He hopes Hongr and Shuisheng will never be parted, and that they will have a new life, unlike his and unlike Runtu's.
Half asleep, he sees the jade green shore and the golden moon once more, and thinks: hope is like a road across the earth.
To begin with there was no road.
But when many people pass one way, a road is made.
